prompts.A: Shot 1: a wide shot of the empty airship deck at dawn, rope rails, the sky brightening, the camera slowly drifting forward. Shot 2: a close shot of the ship's wheel, brass worn bright, turning a little on its own, the camera holding still. Shot 3: a wide shot looking straight up at the great canvas envelope overhead, clouds sliding past behind it, a slow tilt. The shots are connected: the same place, the same lighting and the same visual style across every cut.
